Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this '''Zygerrian''' was working as a enslaver in the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Labor Processing Hub]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]].

==Biography==
This [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] worked in the Labor Processing Hub during the time when [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]] were imprisoned there. This enslaver whipped Obi-Wan with a [[shock whip]] for talking, which was prohibited, then started whipping Roshti as a punishment. When Obi-Wan told him that Roshti should not be punished for his own mistakes, [[Unidentified Zygerrian enslaver 3|another enslaver]] electrocuted him with a rod to his [[Shock collar/Legends|collar]]. This enslaver then said that he does not take commands from a enslaved individual and started to whip the Togruta again until Obi-Wan begged him to stop, calling him his master and asking him for forgiveness.
